[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ha'kosem has been around for over 10 years and is known for its freshly made falafel, delicious toppings, and homemade sauces.  
[USER] User expressed excitement about exploring the falafel stands in Tel Aviv and asked for advice on what to order besides falafel.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested traditional side dishes and toppings to try with falafel:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Hummus - a creamy dip made with chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, and garlic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Tehina - a savory sauce made from sesame seeds, lemon juice, and garlic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Israeli Salad - a refreshing mix of cucumbers, tomatoes, onions, and parsley.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Pickles - sour pickles, cabbage, and turnips are a common addition to falafel sandwiches.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Amba - a tangy and spicy sauce made from pickled mangoes.
